    grid = observation.get("grid", [])
    me = observation.get("me", {})
    resources = observation.get("resources", [])
    opponents = observation.get("opponents", [])
    allies = observation.get("allies", [])
    # Initialize movement vector
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Helper to get position of an entity if possible
    def entity_pos(entity_id):
        for cell in grid:
            if cell.get("entity_id") == entity_id:
                return (cell.get("x"), cell.get("y"))
        return None

    # Determine own position
    my_pos = entity_pos(me.get("entity_id"))

    # If no position info, stay still
    if my_pos is None:
        return [0, 0]

    x, y = my_pos

    # Resource collection behavior
    if resources:
        # Find nearest resource
        def dist(a, b):
            return abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1])
        resource_positions = [ (res.get("x"), res.get("y")) for res in resources if res.get("x") is not None and res.get("y") is not None ]
        if resource_positions:
            target = min(resource_positions, key=lambda pos: dist(pos, (x, y)))
            dx = (target[0] > x) - (target[0] < x)
            dy = (target[1] > y) - (target[1] < y)
            return [dx, dy]

    # Pursuit-evasion: chase nearest opponent
    if opponents:
        opponent_positions = [ (opp.get("x"), opp.get("y")) for opp in opponents if opp.get("x") is not None and opp.get("y") is not None ]
        if opponent_positions:
            target = min(opponent_positions, key=lambda pos: abs(pos[0] - x) + abs(pos[1] - y))
            dx = (target[0] > x) - (target[0] < x)
            dy = (target[1] > y) - (target[1] < y)
            return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control: move towards center
    grid_size = max( max(cell.get("x",0) for cell in grid), max(cell.get("y",0) for cell in grid), 1)
    center = grid_size // 2
    dx = (center > x) - (center < x)
    dy = (center > y) - (center < y)

    return [dx, dy]
